page_title: BIL 1-1 MAL | Athletic Bilbao v Mallorca 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Yellow Cards

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' A corner kick by Mallorca is thwarted by the well prepared Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao).

90+5' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.

90+2' The game is interrupted. Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Inigo Lekue, but sends his close-range header way wide of the right post.
86' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cyle Larin (Mallorca) will replace Vedat Muriqi.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
83' Jose Copete (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Ath Bilbao.
82' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
78' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) replacing Adama Boiro.
78' Alex Berenguer goes off the pitch and Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
76' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for holding. Alejandro Hernandez signals a set piece. Mallorca will take a free kick.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
73' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Jose Copete (Mallorca) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
72' Substitution. Omar Mascarell leaves the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
72' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) replaces Sergi Darder.

70' Fine attempt! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
66' Samu Costa (Mallorca) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
63' The attendance is 48203.
62' Although Ernesto Valverde (Ath Bilbao) is just on the bench, Alejandro Hernandez has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
60' Alejandro Hernandez sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
59' Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez has indicated he is going to review the Ath Bilbao goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
59' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Takuma Asano will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).

58' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) makes it 1:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Andoni Gorosabel and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Dominik Greif was helpless.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Unai Nunez (Ath Bilbao) for Aitor Paredes.
56' 0 - 1 Sergi Darder takes over corner duties and expertly finds Antonio Raillo (Mallorca), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the top right corner. The score is now 0:1.
56' The ball goes behind for a corner. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Good work from Mallorca as they win a corner.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Ath Bilbao is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
54' Here is a change. Peio Canales is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gorka Guruzeta departs the field of play to be replaced by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao).
53' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
49' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
48' The game is interrupted now, Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao). Mallorca win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
43' Jose Copete (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
43' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Mallorca get a free kick.
41' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' A pass by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
35' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is first to the cross from Johan Mojica, but fires his header just past the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
34' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dominik Greif intercepts the ball.
30' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao in a dangerous position.
29' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
28' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

26' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Mallorca are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

25' That was close by Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
21' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Samu Costa (Mallorca). It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
16' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
15' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

10' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends near the left corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
10' Alejandro Hernandez blows the whistle, Jose Copete (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.

7' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

3' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
3' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Hernandez.
